items.title: UW Beats Michigan State 21-14 On TD With 2:24 Left
items.summary: EAST LANSING, Mich. (AP) — Jayden Limar had a tiebreaking, 1-yard touchdown run with 2:24 left and Washington held on to beat Michigan State 21-14 on Saturday night after being one of the teams whose travel plans were delayed by the Federal Aviation Administration's decision to ground all flights.

items.title: Football At MSU Moved To 2:30 p.m. PT Kickoff On Saturday
